supported_device.unsupported_models: All models other than Nokia XG-040G-MD

stock_web_automation.login: encrypted-first; explicit one-time plain HTTP retry remains available
reads: device model (ModelName/chipset) — verified before any write
stock_web_automation.ftp_enable: POST /storage.cgi?ftp_config with ftp_en=true and fresh CSRF; re-read state and verify actual configured port
stock_web_automation.safety: device_status.cgi remains the preferred model confirmation; manual choices 2/3 use a best-effort UID-0 Telnet probe that rejects explicit AN/EN7583, accepts AN/EN7581, and permits inconclusive output after one warning; explicit expert choice 4 skips the model probe and forces direct TFTP after an explicit y/N confirmation; passwords remain in process memory, registered secrets are filtered from session logs, and secrets are not passed through argv

transports.usb_samba: supported; Windows UNC authentication uses useradmin plus the already collected device/label password through WNetAddConnection2W; the secret stays in process memory, with one Nokia-share/IPC$ stale-session retry
transports.usb_ftp: supported with automatic FTP enablement and /mnt/USB chroot path resolution

direct_tftp.retry_policy: reuse one healthy UID-0 Telnet session across successful partitions; reconnect only after timeout, socket/Telnet error, or missing completion marker; validated files retained; Windows UDP connection-reset suppression

telnet.reconnect_policy: up to 3 independent root sessions, each with up to 3 fresh TCP login attempts

verification.ram_uboot: complete logical coverage by per-chunk IBU readback SHA256 plus BL2 readback SHA256; no monolithic all_flash SHA256 is computed in U-Boot
verification.ram_recovery_ssh: IBU and BL2 readback SHA256 plus a final monolithic all_flash SHA256 before reboot

hardware_status.automatic_ftp_enable: code/synthetic validation; controlled hardware confirmation still required if not yet reported
hardware_status.manual_telnet_model_gate: MD evidence confirmed from stock dmesg/U-Boot logs; choices 2/3 are best-effort and expert choice 4 intentionally bypasses the probe; MF rejection remains to be hardware-confirmed
hardware_status.manual_transition_custom_sysupgrade: static/synthetic validated; full hardware cycle pending

operator_progress.telnet_console: command echo and protocol markers suppressed; preflight runtime messages retained
operator_progress.transition_stage: SSH-derived state, steps 1/8..8/8, port changes, and phase-aware 30-second heartbeat
operator_progress.diagnostics: complete raw /tmp/nokia-autoflash.log appended to PC session logs only
operator_progress.usb_network_transfers: FTP and Samba backup/package copies show overall byte percentage, a 20-cell bar, MiB transferred, average speed, file count, and current file; output is line-oriented for clean LATEST.log diagnostics

manual_bundle.behavior: 8 MiB manual transition only; no embedded production image and no autonomous stage 2

expert_custom_sysupgrade.transition: separate manual FIT with no autoflash service
expert_custom_sysupgrade.destructive_gate: second y/N confirmation after remote validation
expert_custom_sysupgrade.fallback: manual transition FIT stored in UBI fit volume
